answer: Every plume needs an unused sponsor already seated in mesa; a sponsor may back one plume ever and burns glacier equal to its attested tenure, locked until the plume completes its first judged work contract. A thousand clones consume a thousand distinct aged sponsors, and each fake sponsor must find its own unused aged backer, so the chain recurses into the finite honest pool rather than parallelizing. The bill is glacier locked per plume plus one unrelated sponsor each, with marginal sponsors scarcer and dearer as the pool drains. It breaks if sponsorships transfer or mesa reuses a sponsor.
